name: install-checkpoint
description: Stops package installs, download-and-run scripts, MCP/plugin additions and edits to Claude settings until a reviewer agent vets them and a human approves.

require_review.title: Require a reviewer verdict
require_review.description: When on, an install is blocked until the install-reviewer agent records a verdict; then you are asked to approve. When off, you are asked to approve every install directly.
